chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Louis in Chick Webb's band and the sore lip
summary: After Russell, Louis went with Chick Webb's band, which was wrong for him, with jealous trumpeters, and strain on his lip from nightly high notes forced him to lay off for about a year.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well I suppose the, you know the Rockwell Agency was sort of manipulating you know because....
That's right. Because after the Louis Russell's group he went with the Chick Webb's band.
That's right. But that didn't last long did it?

No that didn't last long because they made his lip sore. See they weren't right with him at all. That band had him going so. That's when he had to lay off about a year because of the sore lip. He laid off a long time with that sore lip. Because that band made his lip sore.
Well also perhaps at that time he probably was sort of abusing the high note thing to some extent, don't you think?
You know I mean that would become, every show you'd got to go on and blow all these high things.
They would be expecting you to do that you know.
And he probably did abuse himself.
Sure and then the band wasn't right for him.
No it was a different type of thing.
You see the band wasn't clean and nice. See it was a lot of jealousy in there towards Louis. See all those trumpet players and everything. (Beth Jordan Tatt and Gus, Gus......
No it wasn't Gus Aiken it was Gus someone, McCloud or something.
